# OmniTune v0.9.5
**Default App Icon, Notification Branding & System Overhaul**

### 🚀 Features
- **New App Icon:** Replaced default launcher icon across all densities
- **Notification Branding:** Added OmniTune-branded notification icon (`ic_stat_omnitune`) — status bar now shows the app's "O" logo instead of a generic circle icon
- **In-App Header:** Replaced the generic signal bars in the top-left header with the OmniTune app icon
- **Large Notification Artwork:** Notification now displays the full-color app icon as the large artwork during playback
- **Redesigned Overflow Menu:** Updated 3-dot icon to proper Material Design spec
- **New Icons:** Added drag handle, volume, and horizontal more icons

### 🛠️ Fixes
- **Queue Crash:** Fixed crash when removing songs from queue
- **Player Options Sheet:** Fixed layout overflow and alignment issues
- **Listen Together:** Resolved duplicate songs appearing in sessions

### 📦 Build
- **Version:** 0.9.5 (42)
- **Signed APK** built via GitHub Actions release workflow
